component.name: Slowscroll
component.summary: Touchpad scroll speed, acceleration and momentum

description.p: GNOME has no setting for how fast two-finger touchpad scrolling moves. Slowscroll adds one, and makes scrolling feel like a Mac:

ul.li: Two-finger scroll speed, with a smooth acceleration curve: slow movement is precise, a fast flick goes far
The same momentum glide after you lift your fingers in every application; touching the touchpad stops it
Scrolling starts as fast as without Slowscroll
A separate speed for three-finger gestures
Pinch-zoom, taps, clicks and pointer movement are not changed

description.p: Every setting applies within a second and has its own reset button. Slowscroll runs as a background service; turn it on in the settings window.
